ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible area, with high-intensity (white) spikes localized to water droplets and sparse scarring marks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire visible trailing edge; peaks and valleys are most prominent on the medial portion of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the notch transitioning to a slightly concave taper toward the distal tips on the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark pigmentation cluster on the distal right tip forming a recognizable focal pattern.
